Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
15
jdt.
 13.03.2024
 jb.
 Wpa 19619 of 2023
 Mr. Partha Pratim Roy
 Mr. Dyutiman Banerjee
 .... For the Petitioners

Mr. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay
 Ms. Suchana Banerjee
Affidavit of service filed on behalf of the  petitioners is taken on record.

It is contended on behalf of the petitioners that  the notification under Section 3(1) of the West Bengal  Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948 was  published on August 10, 1983 in respect of several plots  including that of the petitioners.

entities.text: West Bengal  Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Though notification  under Section 4(1)(a) of the Act of 1948 was  subsequently issued the acquisition was not proceeded  with and ultimately lapsed.
Possession of the plots was  taken by the respondents.
The petitioners have learnt that the plots in question are being utilised for construction of road under the 'Pathasree Scheme' by the Department of Panchayat and Rural Development.

entities.text: Department of Panchayat and Rural Development
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The petitioners pray for a direction upon the WPA/19619/2023 on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139462083/
1 authority to initiate fresh acquisition proceedings in respect of the said plots and grant compensation to them in terms of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
Learned counsel for the respondents seeks to submit a report in the form of affidavit in this regard.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Let the matter appear under the heading 'Motion' on 18th April, 2024.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
WPA/19619/2023 on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139462083/
2
